title: Add, replace or remove my profile picture
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Compose MUI Avatar and the documented file-upload Button. Preview a local selection, Save or Cancel, remove the picture and fall back to initials. Show the saved avatar in Profile and the account menu.

**Verify** · Validate the actual supported image format, size and decoded dimensions on the server. Test corrupt and oversized images, failed replacement, removing, reopening and changing accounts. A failed save keeps the previous picture.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-056, WI-070

**Queue** · Follows WI-073 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
evidence: The tester uploaded a PNG, saw the served avatar, then removed it and saw the initials fallback. account-extra.test.mjs covers validation, serve and removal.
